problem: Extreme ellipse segment requests could overflow the open-curve vertex-count calculation or cause unbounded work; early refusal left a stale vertexcount.
change: Bound the derived segment count before integer conversion and endpoint addition using the existing one-million-vertex internal resource bound, and reset the output count when clearing the vertices.
validation: dxf_ellipse_extrusion_policy passes; direct open and closed INT_MAX controls reject and retry, while ASCII/Binary R12 export preserves the destination on refusal and the same codec retries with four vertices and fresh readback.
limits: The bound is an implementation resource guard, not a DXF format maximum.
No claim about native curve semantics or physical producer coverage.
